title: Appearance Eligibility and Constraint Model

constraint_classes.meaning: Structural eligibility derives from current governed morphology/body topology.
Eligibility restricted by Species profile source facts.
Eligibility restricted by current governed Form/current-body state.
Life-cycle, metamorphosis, growth, residue or other phase state changes eligibility.
A selection requires another governed option or state.
Selections are mutually incompatible under the same resolved state.
Editor/viewer authority filters selection visibility and mutation authority.

generic_rules.if: editor lacks authority to view/edit the field
generic_rules.then: do not reveal option existence, counts, diagnostics or hidden values; mutation prohibited
preserve allowed=unknown; never coerce unknown to false or true

generic_rules.if: an option requires a body structure absent from resolved topology
generic_rules.then: allowed=false with source-backed reason; do not silently substitute
recompute governed eligibility deterministically against current Form without rewriting reusable Species/Form definitions

generic_rules.if: life-cycle phase changes a structure or presentation
generic_rules.then: phase-specific eligibility controls the structure while preserving stable identity/history
recompute all dependent dimensions deterministically; invalidated committed choices enter explicit review/diagnostic state rather than auto-replacement

generic_rules.if: two source-backed options are mutually exclusive
generic_rules.then: reject simultaneous committed state with explicit conflict evidence
enforce those counts; absence of a sourced count does not authorize an invented default
preserve valid identity/biology state and emit deterministic fallback diagnostic; renderer state never erases source truth

generic_rules.if: visual item resembles equipment or wardrobe
generic_rules.then: presentation may reference it only through PPIA-03 actual Asset/equipment authority; appearance never implies ownership/mechanics

generic_rules.if: source names a dimension but does not enumerate legal values
generic_rules.then: keep selection mode source_bounded_or_unspecified and do not invent canonical options
query authoritative operation/current state before retry; never blind-retry identity mutation
do not silently discard committed biological or identity appearance truth
downstream CAPP-02 may draw only from currently eligible CAPP-01 source-supported pools and must respect locks

profile_rules.effect: All morphology-dependent categories remain allowed=unknown until canonical morphology is recovered; presentation/equipment categories are conditional on independently resolved current-body/topology authority.
All morphology-dependent categories remain allowed=unknown until canonical morphology is recovered; no human-default body plan may be inferred.
Thetan Species does not own a standalone physical body. Resolve physical appearance against occupied body/current-body authority; species-level physical controls are not applicable.
Discrete limb/head/hair controls are ineligible for the native single-cell body unless a separate governed occupied/current Form supplies such topology.
Hatchling phase is wingless; wing-related dimensions become eligible only in a source-supported later phase. No visible-sex-organ control is created from this profile.
Programmed puberty/metamorphosis from Lesser Stage may change topology and size; evaluate adult Logical Stage controls against the current phase/form.
Form/presentation depends on ambient diet, allergens and location; environment may affect current form state but must not rewrite Species source facts.
Gender manifestation follows source-backed sequential life changes; phase-aware eligibility must not flatten them into a fixed human-default model.
Gender is fixed at birth with a source-supported nongendered transition path; do not invent additional transition states.
Post-pubescent grooming presentation can vary while sex organs remain internal; grooming presentation must not be treated as external reproductive anatomy.
Native armless and mouthless phenotype disables arm- and mouth-dependent controls unless current governed Form overrides topology.
Native topology includes four arms, two legs and wing membranes involving middle arms/tail; do not normalize to two-arm humanoid controls.
Native topology distinguishes two general arms from two dedicated flight wings; dedicated wings are not ordinary arm slots.
Native topology has four wings, two larger and two smaller; wing presentation must retain four-wing cardinality where source topology controls.

unknown_and_failure_semantics.unknown: Source/authority is insufficient; keep explicit and diagnosable.
unknown_and_failure_semantics.false: Resolved authority says option/category is not eligible.
unknown_and_failure_semantics.conditional: Eligibility depends on another governed state.

non_authorities: renderer asset availability cannot create or delete Species/Form biology
presentation wardrobe cannot create actual Asset ownership
AI recommendations cannot promote source truth
CAPP-01 does not activate application runtime or STAGE-A-A2
